events.verdict: Dunn (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position as he defends Doncic (LAL) during the drive.
Ayton (LAL) brushes Lopez's (LAC) arm as he pursues the rebound, and the contact is marginal.
Smart (LAL) makes incidental contact with Mathurin's (LAC) hand after contacting the ball.

Replay review of the foul called on Mathurin (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Reaves (LAL) firms up in a legal guarding position in Mathurin's path prior to the start of Mathurin's upward shooting motion.
Batum (LAC) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.
Ayton (LAL) establishes himself in Dunn's (LAC) path prior to the contact.
Dunn (LAC) initiates contact with Doncic's (LAL) arm that is more than marginal during his driving shot attempt.
Miller (LAC) stops short and avoids moving through Reaves' (LAL) space and dislodging him from his position.
Smart (LAL) legally contests Jones Jr.'s (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Lopez (LAC) makes marginal contact to the arm of Reaves (LAL).
Doncic (LAL) and Lopez (LAC) come together in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs during the rebound.
Miller (LAC) initiates illegal contact to Smart's (LAL) arm as he enters his upward shooting motion.
Reaves (LAL) absorbs the contact initiated by Miller (LAC) as he defends him in the post.
Ayton (LAL) initiates contact to Jones Jr.'s (LAC) arm that is more than marginal during his shot attempt near the rim.
Dunn (LAC) swipes down and makes contact to the ball, and the ensuing contact with Doncic (LAL) is incidental.
Dunn (LAC) jumps forward into Doncic (LAL) and initiates illegal contact while he is in his shooting motion.
Reaves (LAL) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Dunn (LAC).
Ayton (LAL) reaches forward and makes illegal contact to Miller's (LAC) arm that affects his shot attempt.
Doncic (LAL) legally contests Batum's (LAC) jump shot attempt.
Multiple players defend James (LAL) before he makes the pass and there is no illegal contact.
